image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a dark grey/brown wombat foraging in green grass. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body with coarse fur. Its head is lowered towards the ground, obscuring the nose and eyes partially, but the broad head shape and rounded ears are visible. The forelimbs appear short and sturdy, tucked under the body.
